card.title: How To Fix Important Display Message Even After Transferring Touch IC

source.title: How To Fix Important Display Message Even After Transferring Touch IC

symptoms: Important Display Message after screen replacement

claims.statement: On iPhone 12–16 screens, the non-genuine display message can remain even after transferring the touch IC, because the new panel lacks the original MTSN pairing data.
Fix before transfer: read the old display's MTSN data on a JC V1SE / V1S Pro and write it to the new display; or after transfer, use the programmer's Fix True Tone function with the phone connected.

procedure: Verify the touch IC transfer is sound.
Method 1: read old display data, write to new display, then transfer touch IC.
Method 2: with phone and new display connected, run Fix True Tone and choose original or third-party panel.
Reboot and confirm the message is gone.
